case: Every question established and attested; the report published; a result and a veto posted after it by two other seats; the coordinator prepared the finish on the report and resolved both in one batch with a key; the same batch was sent again with the same key, as a retry after an interruption.
design: docs/adr/0015 decision 6: the first seat to ask for the finish designates the report's last publisher when it can hold it; a prepare takes the lease as a done does ("Preparing the finish").

docs/adr/0015 "Preparing the finish": prepare runs no goal check and writes no sentinel; it lists every item late against the report; a batch records one resolution event per item, carrying its key, and a retry with the same key records nothing twice.
docs/adr/0015 decision 10: once every late item has a typed resolution nothing holds the coordinator's done on what is late.
